lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: At least four horizontal rows of roughly circular high-luminance spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a repeating grid pattern along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots at regular intervals, creating a lattice-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-contrast gradient with brightness on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
